g.text: Repeated source work grows with the batch count
All triangles retained. Contiguous part groups share source arrays. Bus: three runs. San Miguel: one run.
Separate full-part control: San Miguel, 2,203 batches, degenerates 196.7 s (358 times the one-batch time).
